create_put_model: create a device model from a MuJoCo MjModel using put_model for GPU simulation
create_make_data: create a device data object with make_data specifying world count and contact limits
create_put_data: move host MuJoCo MjData to a device data object using put_data for GPU simulation
create_get_data_into: get device data back into a MuJoCo MjData object using get_data_into for host access
create_reset_data: reset device data to defaults with reset_data clearing contacts and resetting qpos to qpos0
create_set_const: recompute qpos0-dependent constant model fields using set_const after modifying model parameters
create_override_model: override model parameters like opt.iterations or opt.cone using override_model with string key-value pairs
create_create_render_context: create a GPU render context with create_render_context enabling RGB depth and segmentation output
create_load_trajectory: load a ctrl trajectory from an NPZ file and interpolate to model timestep using load_trajectory
